title: Airport Go-Karts
specs: Largest oval concession kart track in the Northeastern United States, 621 feet race line
Rookie Karts top speed 18 mph, Pro Karts top speed 28 mph
Rookie Karts: drivers 54" and taller, recommended 10 years or older
Pro Karts: drivers 16 years and older, 54" and taller, valid picture ID required
Double Kart driver must be 18 years or older, passenger 36" to 54" tall

blurb: Guests drive either Rookie or Pro karts on a 621-foot race line track. Rookie karts are for drivers 54" and taller, with a top speed of 18 mph and about 10 laps per 4-minute race. Pro karts are for drivers 16 years and older, 54" and taller, with a top speed of 28 mph and about 12 laps per 4-minute race.
extraNote: No single seat kart passengers on lap allowed · Discounts for groups: 8+ tickets $1 off each, 25+ tickets $2 off each, 50+ tickets $3 off each · Discounts for organizations with letterhead: $1 off each ticket, $5 off Rookie all day pass, $10 off Pro pass · No refund for lost time due to rule violations
